name: std::unordered_map<Key,T,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::begin, std::unordered_map<Key,T,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::cbegin
intro:
Returns an iterator to the first element of the unordered_map.

If the unordered_map is empty, the returned iterator will be equal to end().

examples.output:
The magnitude of (3, 3) is 4.24264
The magnitude of (1, 1) is 1.41421
The magnitude of (2, 2) is 2.82843
The magnitude of (3, 4.24264) is 5.19615
The magnitude of (1, 1.41421) is 1.73205
The magnitude of (2, 2.82843) is 3.4641

summary: Returns an iterator to the first element of the unordered_map.
